inputs.statement: p is a prime number and K has characteristic p.

V is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl₂(ℂ)-module of highest weight λ, of complex dimension λ+1. The Chevalley generators x,y,h of sl₂(ℂ) act on V and satisfy [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=−2y, [x,y]=h. In its universal enveloping algebra and in the induced operators on V, the bracket is [a,b]=ab−ba; the same symbols denote the corresponding operators.
M⊂V is an arbitrary admissible lattice: a free abelian subgroup admitting an integer basis which is also a complex basis of V, and stable under U_Z. No minimal-lattice assumption is imposed.

n=λ+1>0 and |I|=n. For every integer t≥0, h y^t v=(λ−2t)y^t v; for t≥1, x y^t v=t(λ−t+1)y^(t−1)v. The vectors (e_i)_{i∈I} form a complex basis of V, and y^(λ+1)v=0 (hence all higher lowering powers vanish). On this basis, xe_0=0, xe_i=(λ−i+1)e_(i−1) for 1≤i≤λ, ye_i=(i+1)e_(i+1) for 0≤i<λ, ye_λ=0, he_i=(λ−2i)e_i. For all i∈I and natural r, X_r e_i=binom(λ−i+r,r)e_(i−r) if r≤i and zero otherwise; Y_r e_i=binom(i+r,r)e_(i+r) if i+r≤λ and zero otherwise. All displayed divided-power coefficients are integers.

output.statement: iota embeds M_R as the R-span of M in V; M_R is free of rank n over R and its complex span is V. Each X_r and Y_r (r≥0) preserves M and M_R, and x,y,h preserve M and M_R. For every i,j∈I, E_ij preserves M_R (under iota). The following identities hold on V: Pi=Y_λ X_λ=E_λλ, X_(λ−i)Pi=E_iλ, Pi Y_(λ−j)=binom(λ,j)E_λj, and E_ij=binom(λ,j)^(-1) X_(λ−i)Pi Y_(λ−j), where binom(λ,j) is a unit in R.

argument.text: Use N001 and H002 to count |I|=n. By H005 choose an integer basis m of M which is also a complex basis of V; its cardinality is n since the e basis of N001 has n elements. Tensoring the integer coordinate isomorphism with R gives R-coordinates on M_R: finite sums ∑_{i∈I}r_i⊗m_i have unique coefficients r_i∈R. Explicitly the coordinate homomorphisms of M extend to these coordinates, and the sum map is their inverse. Under iota these basis tensors go to m_i, still complex-linearly independent, so iota is injective. This proves freeness of rank n and shows its image spans V over ℂ. Admissibility H005 gives preservation of M by every X_r,Y_r; extension by R gives preservation of M_R. In particular x=X_1 and y=Y_1 preserve them; h=xy−yx by H003 preserves them too.

produces.statement: iota is injective, M_R is free of rank n with complex span V, and every X_r,Y_r and x,y,h preserves M and M_R.

argument.text: Compose the identities F002. On the e basis, E_iλ E_λj=E_ij; thus E_ij=binom(λ,j)^(-1)X_(λ−i)Pi Y_(λ−j). Every factor on the right preserves M_R by F001, and the scalar inverse belongs to R by F002. Consequently E_ij preserves M_R for all i,j. Together with F001 and F002 these are the asserted lattice and matrix-unit identities. This reasoning has used distinct complex weights only in N001 and makes no assertion about distinct weights modulo p.
